name: Tianhehui
source:
The story Tianhehui tells is about the adventure of an ordinary novelist, Tex, who comes all the way from Moro and sets foot on this eastern continent, the land of Xi, to collect drawing materials and broaden his horizons.

Later, to retrieve a very precious treasure stolen by a thief, Tex chooses to entrust these two kind-hearted people who have a sense of justice, a white wolf and a yellow tiger named Baiyu and Chenhu.

He then joins the team at their invitation. This is where the story begins. The hidden, unknown past and the mystery over the years on Tex will involve him in a huge dispute that would start a new era on this eastern continent.

[Edited from [url=https://delaxquill.itch.io/tianhehui]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《天和会》讲述了一位普通小说家泰克斯千里迢迢从莫罗来到这片东方大陆——希的土地，收集绘画素材、开阔眼界的冒险经历。

后来，为了找回被小偷偷走的一件非常珍贵的宝物，特克斯选择委托给白宇和陈虎这两个善良而富有正义感的人——白狼和黄虎。

然后他应他们的邀请加入了团队。这就是故事的开始。泰克斯上隐藏的、不为人知的过去和多年来的谜团将使他卷入一场巨大的争端，这将在这片东方大陆上开启一个新时代。

[编辑自[url=https://delaxquill.itch.io/tianhehui]Itch.io[/url]]
